page.overview:
Who is Amino?

In the novel, Iō's daughter married and moved away from the Bamboo Village to another village nearby. She was about to give birth to her first child, but was killed along with the rest of the villagers during an attack by the Dark Thunder Group. Her mother died from grief on hearing the news and her father swore revenge.

In the anime, when Chino and Nowaki arrived in the Bamboo Village, Amino was kind to them and prepared meals for them.

Chino referred to Amino as being a very great person.

Amino was a young woman with short brown hair and large brown eyes. She wore a tan-coloured kimono.
